light.line: Shine Through Faith, a Marshfield nonprofit founded by Heather Rodriguez, began with volunteers helping elderly neighbors stay in their homes and now runs a resource center for families, foster children and teachers.
A Lebanon church built a wheelchair ramp for neighbor Tiffany Walker, who lives with a rare condition called Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, to make her daily life easier.
BTC Bank surprised the City of Buffalo with a 50,000 dollar check that completes the funding for phase one of the Buffalo Community Center repairs.
A Lake of the Ozarks nonprofit is helping women rebuild their lives with a safe place to sleep, a working phone, transportation and someone in their corner.

Rockin' Rogersville, now in its ninth year, grew into a full family festival with 33 vendors, nine food trucks, five bands and a new kids' zone, raising money for the Community Foundation of Rogersville.
LakeExpo reports an Olathe, Kansas, angler snagging for the very first time pulled a 164-pound world-record paddlefish out of Lake of the Ozarks recently.
